name: Hacker News
summary: Social news site where users submit, upvote and discuss technology and startup links.
description: A link aggregator run by Y Combinator: user-submitted stories on software, startups and science, each with a points score and a comment thread. Sections cover new, past, comments, ask, show and jobs; the footer links guidelines, an FAQ, lists and an API, and YC batch applications are promoted on the page.
contains: front page of ranked stories with points, submitter and comment counts
sections: new, past, comments, ask, show, jobs and submit
stories link out to the source; each has a comment thread
footer links guidelines, FAQ, lists, API, security and legal
